# Real test-data fixtures — sources & attribution

These are **small clipped samples of real open data**, committed so the test suite can
exercise the true code paths (real CRS reprojection, real depth values, the real NUTS
schema, an end-to-end query over a real index) instead of only synthetic/mocked data.
They are regenerated by [`scripts/make_test_fixtures.py`](../../../scripts/make_test_fixtures.py).

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `efas_depth_clip.tif` | A 384×384 crop of a JRC/Copernicus **CEMS-EFAS Satellite-Derived Flood Depth Map** tile (native metric CRS, depth in centimetres, nodata 0). | CC-BY-4.0 |
| `index/` (COG + `flood_dictionary.parquet` + `events.parquet` + manifest) | Derived from the same CEMS-EFAS depth maps — a small ROI (Zutphen, on the IJssel) clip of the EuroFlood index. | CC-BY-4.0 |
| `nuts_subset.geojson` | A handful of regions from the **Eurostat GISCO NUTS 2024** boundaries (`NUTS_RG_20M_2024_4326`), plus one appended **Zutphen** municipality boundary from **OpenStreetMap** (Nominatim) — Zutphen is a municipality, absent from NUTS, so it is added for offline geocoding. | © EuroGeographics (NUTS); © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL (Zutphen) |
